corona_native.label: CoronaEngine native ReSTIRGI
corona_native.GI_scope_note: Native suffix/reuse/shading only; mandatory primary candidate producer is in GI_plus_preparation. Old port preparation did not charge its unrelated native DI initial scope.

validation.build_and_benchmark_evidence: Archived per-experiment verification files contain exact build/source/runtime hashes.

known_limits: Current Corona port brightness bias is +15.38% in static gray Kitchen.
Native Corona has rare bright outliers and repeat-sensitive RMS noise; outliers retained.
Equal new-candidate paths do not imply equal reuse or total ray budgets.
Native GI primary candidate generation is fused into DI; compare GI plus preparation, with fused direct work disclosed.
Original RestirGI means the prior controlled full-resolution/AO1 adaptation, not untouched stock.
RTXPT main-loop wall is normal pipelined throughput with natural CPU/GPU overlap, not same-frame input-to-GPU-completion latency.
Motion, disocclusion and complex-material quality are not established by these captures.

restoration.layout: Restore files using archived_files[].original_local_path relative to the checkout. Archived test*.py.snapshot files retain exact test bytes but avoid pytest discovery; restore them to their recorded .py paths before running experiment tests.
restoration.source_patches: Apply archived RTXPT one-bounce app patch then multibounce patch; wall timing patch is relative to that multibounce snapshot. Original RestirGI patch is relative to source-changes.json baseline. RTXDI patch and source manifests are archived.
restoration.local_only: Original large scenes, SDK/build caches, per-pixel raw quality/reference captures and most process run folders remain in local .workspace; their hashes/locations are retained. Archived results are retained without those large inputs.
restoration.mainloop_scalar_evidence: All three mainloop/GPU scalar CSVs and runtime settings are archived; these are sufficient to inspect/recompute wall statistics.
